items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: Because she’s doing an Ellington album with Mercer Ellington.

ctx.x: Nice. To wrap up, I’m wondering if your parents lived long enough to see your path come to fruition?

My dad came to some gigs at which I was doing all my own songs. And he got a huge kick out of it because people would come up to him and say, “Oh Leonard, the apple doesn’t fall far from the tree.” He was a huge supporter of my lyric writing ambitions and in fact when he was in the hospital in Encino Tarzana Hospital and very sick, I remember him saying, “Did you send Cleo Laine your Ellington re-dos? Because she’s doing an Ellington album with Mercer Ellington. Did you send them to her?” And I was able to go,…
Excellent. Well congratulations on your career, and this has been a really fascinating conversation.
